hook: Why did 164 nations vote to promote maps over Mercator?

sections.voiceover: Why did 164 nations vote to promote maps over Mercator?
b_roll: World map showing Mercator distortion alongside votes counter

sections.voiceover: On September 4, 2026, the United Nations General Assembly endorsed accurate map projections. Where did this 1569 map create major size distortions?
b_roll: United Nations General Assembly voting hall

sections.voiceover: Yet the United States cast the sole vote against the resolution.
b_roll: Voting tally board displaying 164 yes to 1 no

sections.voiceover: American delegates dismissed the initiative as part of a radical ideological project. Flattening a spherical globe has challenged humanity for over 2000 years.
b_roll: Official statement document from US delegation
Graphic showing size expansion near northern and southern poles
3D globe flattening animation across 2000 year timeline

sections.voiceover: Now 164 Member States endorse maps showing true continent sizes.
b_roll: Equal-area world map projection displaying accurate continent proportions
